title: Investigative Post: Genesee County residents urge IDA to reject data center, subsidies (2026-03-20)
why: PILO-e9ad8b primary scene. Batavia resident Rebecca LeFevre asks ChatGPT whether the Stream/STAMP data center is a good idea, then reads the chatbot's verdict aloud as public testimony. Pilobolus: a neighbor volunteers the machine's words into the public record against the machines. Verified on page; reporter J. Dale Shoemaker.
